step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript depict JFrog's SaaS offering on AWS, highlighting public access and private access routes for customers. Public traffic enters via a Public NLB into an EKS cluster housing isolated customer namespaces. For private access, AWS customers connect through a VPC Endpoint to AWS PrivateLink, which routes into a Private NLB and the EKS cluster. On-premises environments connect via Direct Connect and Transit Gateway (or directly through EC2) to the VPC Endpoint. The EKS cluster interacts with Amazon RDS for metadata and Amazon S3 for binary artifact storage.

graph.name: JFrog SaaS Architecture with AWS PrivateLink
